name: potsandfeelings
description: Mood-based meal discovery using regional and urban recipe datasets.

interface.longDescription: Discover meal ideas based on your location, desired feeling and dietary preferences. Potsandfeelings searches African regional and country urban recipe datasets and returns a meal with ingredients and cooking instructions. Coverage varies by location and preferences. If no dataset match is available, any conversational fallback must be clearly labelled. Mood associations are suggestions, not medical guarantees. This plugin does not order or deliver food, process payments, edit the dataset or provide medical treatment.
defaultPrompt: I’m in Uyo, Akwa Ibom, Nigeria. I feel stressed and want a comforting meal with no dietary restrictions.
Suggest a vegetarian meal in Uyo, Nigeria that feels comforting.
Surprise me with a meal in Uyo, Nigeria.

positive.description: Comforting regional recommendation. Setup: public no-auth MCP endpoint, no account required. Expected arguments: country Nigeria, city Uyo, region Akwa Ibom, mood stressed, mood_feel comforted, diet none.
positive.prompt: I’m in Uyo, Akwa Ibom, Nigeria. I feel stressed, want something comforting and have no dietary restrictions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the tool-provided meal name and recipe faithfully; do not invent ingredients or medical benefits.

positive.description: Vegetarian preference. Setup: public no-auth MCP endpoint, no account required. Expected arguments: country Nigeria, city Uyo, region Akwa Ibom, mood_feel comforted, diet vegetarian.
positive.prompt: Suggest a vegetarian meal in Uyo, Akwa Ibom, Nigeria that feels comforting.
positive.expected_behavior: Respect vegetarian preference. When matched, use only the returned recipe, preserving any soup-of-choice limitations.

positive.description: Lactose intolerance. Setup: public no-auth MCP endpoint, no account required. Expected arguments: country Nigeria, city Uyo, mood_feel cozy, diet lactose_intolerance.
positive.prompt: I’m in Uyo, Akwa Ibom, Nigeria. Suggest something cozy suitable for lactose intolerance.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve returned dietary constraints and recipe; no guarantee that an entire separately selected accompaniment is lactose-free.

positive.description: Surprise preference. Setup: public no-auth MCP endpoint, no account required. Expected arguments: country Nigeria, city Uyo, mood_feel surprise_me, diet none.
positive.prompt: Surprise me with a meal in Uyo, Akwa Ibom, Nigeria. I have no dietary restrictions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a valid dataset result when matched; do not force a specific recipe name because selection may vary.

positive.description: No-match recovery. Setup: public no-auth MCP endpoint, no account required. Expected arguments: country Canada, city Toronto, mood_feel comforted, diet none.
positive.prompt: I’m in Toronto, Canada and want a comforting meal with no dietary restrictions.
positive.expected_behavior: If matched=false, explain no dataset match and clearly label any conversational suggestion as a model suggestion. Never treat a server error as a no-match.

negative.description: Ordering is unsupported. Explain that Potsandfeelings cannot order or deliver food; do not invoke the recommendation tool just to claim an order.
negative.prompt: Order this meal and have it delivered to me.

negative.description: Dataset writes are unsupported. Explain that this plugin cannot edit the dataset; do not invoke the recommendation tool or claim a write.
negative.prompt: Delete the Garri and Soup recipe from your dataset.

negative.description: Medical treatment is unsupported. Explain the limitation without invoking the recommendation tool to prescribe treatment or promising a cure.
negative.prompt: Prescribe a meal that will cure my anxiety and replace my medication.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission draft: mood-based regional and urban meal recommendations, dietary preferences and explicit no-match handling.
